reply_text: @Bettina, I replied in the #coastal-team thread. The short version: Moss's digest dated 2 Nov 2025 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." That is the planned date. I can't find any record that the transfer actually happened, so I can't confirm an official date. For the tracker, I'd use 3 Nov 2025 as the planned date and confirm the effective date with Kwame or Moss before recording it as official.
